Thermal Shock Chambers TSA series
Product catalog summary
Overview: The document provides comprehensive details on the TSA Series Air to Air Thermal Shock Chambers by ESPEC CORP, emphasizing improvements in energy efficiency and reliability.
Specifications: The TSA series achieves 35-50% energy savings through an Eco operation mode and a parallel refrigerator control system, optimizing pre-cooling and pre-heating periods.
Procedures: Designed for high and low-temperature exposure tests, the chambers adhere to standards like MIL-STD-883H and IEC 60068-2-14, detailing temperature ranges, exposure, and recovery times.
Features: Notable features include a vertical sliding door, round cable port, defrost-free operation, and support for continuous operation up to 500 hours.
Refrigeration System: Enhanced for reliability, the system uses improved materials to prevent leaks and reduce thermal stress, conforming to ISO and CE safety standards.
Instrumentation: A color LCD touch-screen simplifies operation, offering test halt presets, continuity selection, and auxiliary functions for usability.
Test Standards and Models: Lists compatible models and standards, emphasizing specimen quantity and setting methods for optimal results.
Chamber and Utility Requirements: Specifications for EL, ES, and EH models include air-cooled and water-cooled versions, with power supply needs from 200 VAC to 415 VAC and air supply pressure between 0.4 to 0.7 MPa.
Performance Specifications: Chambers support two-zone or three-zone testing, with temperature ranges from +60°C to +200°C and -70°C to 0°C, maintaining a fluctuation of ±0.5°C.
Construction and Refrigeration: Built with rust-proof steel and stainless interiors, insulated with glass wool and polyurethane foam, featuring a cascade refrigeration system with R404A and R23 refrigerants.
Safety Devices: Equipped with leakage breakers, circuit breakers, overheat protection switches, and thermal relays for safe operation.
Accessories and Options: Includes specimen baskets, shelf brackets, and cable port plugs, with an option for continuous testing without defrosting for up to 500 hours.
Warnings and Cautions: Advises against using explosive, flammable, or corrosive substances and stresses reading the user manual for safety and proper use.
